open_points.subject: rules.http_router_backend route-set revision
open_points.text: “50 routes since the six challenge routes left on 2026-11-07, A10; 56 in the accepted spec, Factory `300bd11d` … `a6916180314d`” gives only a count; it neither identifies the six method/path entries removed nor provides a 50-route backend artifact. A13’s six removed audit actions do not establish a one-to-one mapping to HTTP routes.
open_points.question: Exactly which six method/path contracts must be deleted from the accepted 56-route backend, and is the later router closure/context to treat a revised 50-route backend or the cited 56-route Factory backend plus a deletion delta as authoritative?
options: Remove the issue/completion route pairs for email verification, email change and password reset, then regenerate a 50-route backend and closure/context.
Retain some formerly inert challenge-associated routes and remove a different set of six routes inferred from the accepted backend.
Keep the cited 56-route backend as the closure input and apply the six-route removal only in a later HTTP layer.
open_points.default_guess: Remove the six issue/completion routes inferred for email verification, email change and password reset, and make a regenerated 50-route backend authoritative.

witness.initial: The accepted router backend contains 56 routes, including multiple routes associated with the former staff challenge feature; the current text supplies no route catalog or exact deletion list.
events: The 2026-11-07 owner decision removes the challenge feature and the changed State 2 line requires a 50-route router.
One later agent derives the deleted routes from the six removed audit-action names; another derives them from which accepted handlers referenced challenge models or repositories.
A caller invokes a formerly accepted challenge-associated method/path on the generated service.
outcomes: That method/path is absent and receives the router’s unmatched-route response.
That method/path remains present, while a different challenge-associated method/path was removed to preserve the stated total of 50 routes.
witness.observer: An API client, and later agents comparing the generated router closure or API description.
